messages:
maya: Observed an uptick in frontplane voltage-fluct alerts on rack-7 in ord-ia. ~30 GPUs showing transient voltage dips; we've seen correlated ECC/Xid spikes.

alex: Any common serials or manufacture lot yet?

maya: Early correlation points to a cluster of units from lot SN-8A2 and a handful of A100 v2s running frontplane sensor fw 1.14.

jordyn: Pasted a trimmed log from one affected host: 
```
[2026-03-10 03:12:05] voltage-sensor: delta=0.62V
[2026-03-10 03:12:08] gpu0: ecc=soft, xid=43
[2026-03-10 03:12:12] gpu0: thermal=OK, pmic-reset
```
Link: <internal/logs/ord-ia/rack7/voltage-dump-200800>

sre-bot: Alert: voltage-spike pattern detected on rack-7 -> auto-drain triggered for affected nodes (task: drain-node-2008-01).

samir: How many nodes were drained and what's the capacity hit for ord-ia GPU pool?

maya: 6 nodes drained (24 GPUs). That's ~8% of ord-ia GPU pool. No user-facing failures yet but tail latency for medium priority jobs increased.

lucy: Can we shift low-priority batch work to other regions temporarily? Cost impact?

alex: We routed batch-queues to us-west-2 as a temporary measure. Rough cost bump estimated +$2k/day if this continues.

jordyn: Hypothesis: frontplane voltage sensor drift causes intermittent regulator resets -> memory soft-errors -> ECC/Xid. Firmware 1.14 seems to amplify the symptom window.

maya: Bench repro: applying a +0.5V offset to the sensor replicates Xid within 3-5 minutes on the bench unit. Filing RMA talk with vendor, bench notes attached.

samir: OK. Detection and mitigation asks?

maya: Proposed immediate actions:
- add a voltage-slope alert (avg delta > 0.5V over 30s)
- blacklist node after 3 Xid events within 10m (auto-pre-drain)
- tag inventory by manufacture lot SN-8A2 and prioritize replacements

lucy: Also recommend pinning new firmware 1.15 as canary on a couple of benches and not rolling until 48h good telemetry.

alex: Agree. Also need a capacity playbook entry: if >5% of region pool drained, auto-start spare reservations or notify sales for quota impact.

jordyn: For the RCA doc: likely a two-factor failure vector: specific manuf lot hardware + sensor firmware revision. Action items: RMA lot, firmware canary, detection rules, capacity playbook update.

maya: I'll draft the postmortem and open RMA/schedule tickets. Planning note: replacement throughput limited by vendor and ops runway.

ops: Acknowledged. Earliest swap runway is 72 hours; we'll target the next maintenance window. Ops will coordinate rack access and replacement slots.

sre-bot: Incident status: partial remediation applied. 4 nodes replaced and patched with fw-1.15 canary; remaining affected nodes scheduled for RMA. Postmortem required.

maya: Thanks all. I'll post the RCA + timeline in #postmortems once the draft is ready. :thumbsup:
